profile.headline: Software Engineer | Sales Engineer | Solutions Engineering | Business-First Systems Consulting
profile.summary:
I’m a Software Engineer and Sales Engineer with 10+ years of experience building backend systems, data-driven applications, integrations, and operational platforms.

Throughout my career, much of my work has involved understanding a business or operational problem first and then determining what the software and data need to do.

I’ve worked on research and data-visualization systems, public-health planning applications, e-commerce pricing and marketplace integrations, warehouse operations, inventory systems, and post-acquisition systems integration. The environments have been different, but the underlying work has often been similar: understand the process and business rules, identify friction, and develop a practical solution.

I’ve worked on integrating order and inventory systems following an acquisition, improving warehouse picking and receiving workflows, addressing inventory concurrency problems, developing marketplace pricing systems, repairing organizational-planning data exports, and building reporting and visualization tools around complex operational data.

My technical background includes PHP/Laravel, Python, SQL/MySQL, JavaScript, APIs, system integrations, automated testing, cloud infrastructure, and production support. That foundation allows me to evaluate technical feasibility, understand architecture, communicate with engineering teams, and participate directly in implementation.

I approach solutions by asking: What problem are we actually trying to solve? What is it worth solving? What systems and constraints already exist? Should we configure, integrate, buy, build, automate—or sometimes leave the process alone?

That combination draws me to Sales and Solutions Engineering: understanding the customer’s business, identifying opportunities, shaping technical solutions, communicating value and tradeoffs, and helping move an opportunity from business need to implementation.

I’m also deepening my machine-learning skills with Python, scikit-learn, and PyTorch. I see ML, AI, and automation as tools for problems involving prediction, pricing, recommendation, analysis, decision support, and operational workflows—not technologies that need to be added everywhere.

I’m interested in Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Software Engineer, and technical consulting opportunities where business development, technical problem-solving, communication, and implementation come together.

positions.title: Software Engineer - AI Agent Evaluator [Contract]
positions.description:
- Develop complex coding problems and technical benchmarks to evaluate and train large language models and AI coding agents.
- Document verified solutions, test suites, and technical rationales for model fine-tuning and evaluation.
- Maintain high standards for code quality, accuracy, and throughput across technical evaluation workflows.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Large Language Models (LLM) · AI Agents · Code Review

positions.title: Founder / Independent Consultant
positions.description:
- Design and develop Laravel/PHP applications, REST APIs, database solutions, and workflow integrations while using
executable simulations to analyze operational processes and custom-software opportunities.
- Continuing structured machine-learning study in Python, scikit-learn, and PyTorch, building on a career centered on
operational data, automation, and decision-support systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · PHP · Machine Learning

positions.title: Back End Engineer
positions.description:
- Built and maintained PHP/Laravel integrations connecting World of Books order flows with U.S. inventory and
fulfillment systems, automating order ingestion, allocation, reconciliation, diagnostics, and fulfillment-status
exchange.
- Implemented and merged atomic inventory claims using conditional SQL updates, affected-row validation, and SKU
fallback so competing requests could not both successfully claim the same final available unit through that allocation
path.
- Implemented and refined section-density and aisle-based shipment batching for warehouse picking, supporting
configured production batches of up to 850 small, 230 medium, and 35 large shipments.
- Modernized post-acquisition receiving with 500-row bulk operations, cached lookups, and batch ID reconciliation,
replacing a class of per-item origin-system writes with batched database operations.
- Hardened fulfillment-event synchronization by isolating malformed queue records and preserving diagnostics so
unrelated valid events could continue processing.
- Refactored marketplace-pricing database processing with staged target sets, targeted joins, composite indexing,
instrumentation, and benchmark tooling; separately analyzed experimental eBay repricing history covering about
1.69 million distinct ASINs.
- Migrated custom U.S. software workloads from AWS to Google Cloud Platform and supported monitoring and
operational reliability across integrated systems.

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description:
- Modernized legacy PHP warehouse and eCommerce applications with Laravel, supporting receiving, inventory,
fulfillment, marketplace listing, and pricing workflows.
- Built the foundational World of Books receive-order integration and related inventory-selection, mapping,
reconciliation, cancellation, and diagnostic capabilities later used in the broader post-acquisition integration.
- Developed marketplace pricing, inventory, and synchronization workflows spanning eBay, AbeBooks, Amazon-related
data sources, and Indaba.

positions.title: Career transition
positions.description: Focused on technical professional development, including algorithms and data structures, PHP application architecture, systems programming, C++, analytics, and independent software consulting.

positions.title: Package Handler
positions.description: Part-time package handling and warehouse operations while pursuing technical professional development and preparing for a return to software engineering.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Reengineered a production PAHO strategic-planning workflow across headquarters, PAHO Representations, and
country users, implementing revised proposal, concurrence, confirmation, permissions, ownership, and bilingual
reporting behavior in PHP/MySQL.
- Repaired Workday-facing EIB export completeness by tracing relational, grouping, manager-mapping, and ownership
rules; resolved 23 reported omissions and achieved stakeholder-validated coverage of all 383 initiatives referenced by
the Projects export.
- Developed PHP/SQL reconciliation routines for planning and HR data across organizational hierarchies, investigating
an $886,000 reporting discrepancy and correcting aggregation and business-semantics issues across affected cost
centers.
David Garcia | Software Engineering Career Profile | 1
- Grew into primary application maintenance and production support across planning systems, including releases,
Apache/PHP configuration, SSO/SSL, backups, reporting, data corrections, and production incidents.

positions.title: Programmer II Research Analyst
positions.locationName: Silver Spring, Maryland, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Developed dynamic jQuery forms and study/site editing workflows for an established research information system,
including validation, save/add behavior, AJAX interactions, and automated tests.
- Added PHP/Zend controller and model tests with PHPUnit, resolving bootstrap, test-database, fixture, foreign-key, and
database-dependent testing issues.
- Maintained research-data visualization and reporting features, including CAB metric and specimen-shipment fixes,
JavaScript/AJAX testing, and refactoring for testability.
- Worked on study/site editing, AngularJS-related tab functionality, and financial-disclosure reporting in an Oracle-
backed application.

positions.title: Management Analyst
positions.description:
- Supported NIH/NIAID/DAIDS/OCSO clinical-research administrative and site-catalog information systems, working
with relational data, reporting, visualization, and web application development.
- Developed an experimental PHP/MySQL redevelopment of an existing CTU/Clinical Research Site catalog, using
JavaScript/jQuery, AJAX/JSON, relational reporting, pharmacy/site workflows, and Google Maps to explore a more
maintainable presentation of complex site relationships.
- Built reporting approaches for proposed and historical CTU/CRS relationships, including site merges, additional
locations, investigator relationships, and application-cohort views; also explored database indexing and query
organization for the experimental rewrite.

projects.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Certification Preparation
projects.description:
Preparing for the Linux Foundation Model Context Protocol Associate (MCPA) certification through structured study of MCP architecture, AI agent integration, and practical application development.

Preparation focuses on MCP hosts, clients, servers, tools, resources, prompts, interaction lifecycles, JSON-RPC communication, transport mechanisms, and security considerations.

Study includes MCP technical documentation, AI Agents with MCP by Kyle Stratis, and hands-on exploration of MCP implementations using AI-assisted development tools.

projects.title: PyTorch Machine Learning Certification Preparation
projects.description: Preparing for the Linux Foundation PyTorch certification through structured study of machine learning fundamentals and applied PyTorch. Current preparation includes Machine Learning with PyTorch and Scikit-Learn by Sebastian Raschka, followed by Linux Foundation PyTorch training and hands-on implementation work.
